newsitem.title: USA: Ivax gets preliminary ok on 200mg Acyclovir.
newsitem.headline: Ivax gets preliminary ok on 200mg Acyclovir.

text.p: IVAX Corp said Wednesday the United States Food and Drug Administration granted tentative approval of its abbreviated new drug application for Acyclovir in 200 mg capsules.
IVAX announced on March 3, 1997 that it had received FDA tentative approval to market Acyclovir in 400 and 800 mg tablets.

The generic equivalent of Glaxo Wellcome's Zovirax, Acyclovir is indicated for the treatment of genital herpes, herpes zoster (shingles) and chickenpox, and is the generic equivalent of Glaxo Wellcome's Zovirax.
IVAX said generic versions of acyclovir may not be marketed or sold in the U.S. pursuant to an ANDA prior to April 22, 1997, the date that the patent for Zovirax expires.
